newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RTZ-CRA sees volume up, tax rate down in 1997.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RTZ-CRA sees volume up, tax rate down in 1997.

text.p: RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd said on Thursday higher volumes and a lower effective tax rate would underpin the group's 1997 performance.
Executive chairman Robert Wilson said the group was not short of growth opportunities.
"I expect our growth to continue at a rate in advance of the market overall," Wilson told a televised news conference from London.
"Our key challenge isn't volume growth, it is to maintain and preferably expand margins even during periods of price decline," he said.
Finance director Chris Bull said he expected the group's effective tax rate to fall to 34 percent in 1997.
The effective tax rate was 36 percent in 1996.
The Anglo-Australian mining giant earlier reported its 1996 net profit fell to US$1.096 billion from $1.441 billion in 1995.
